pairs.why: A's hero is a mid-to-dark green with darker pillars and a darker pool band at the bottom, like the real card's value groups, while B's bright interior water and wide pale tile area push it lighter.
The two are nearly identical in value; B has a slightly softer, lighter glow behind the rope and less dark corner build-up, which sits closer to the real cards' even, bright backgrounds.

B has real dark accents in the amber visor and the purple floor, so the helmet gets value structure like the real shoes, vending machine and camera, while A is a high-key white blob with little internal contrast.
A's wall is a deeper mid green with darker corners and a gentle white unit, matching the real mid-key card, while B is washed out and yellowed in the lower half.
B's mass of mid-dark red dominates the hero as it does on the real card, while A's large white lid and collar make it lighter and push the hero's weight toward white.

B keeps a darker navy body and more saturated orange corners around a central glow, closer to the real dark hero on a glowing yellow field, while A's creamy keys and white-yellow glow wash out the key.
A's hero fills more of the card with a dark underside and glow behind it, as the real card does, whereas B's small hero leaves a large flat orange area.
B's dark navy truss and dark hero against a mid-bright blue field match the real card's dark top band and value grouping, while A's bright silver truss adds a light shape the real card lacks.
